architecture.mechanism: Neutral braking mode determination by motor controller processor
architecture.intervention: Implement a processor-based logic gate in the automatic emergency braking and vehicle park system that verifies a neutral braking mode state before authorizing reverse movement or emergency brake application, preventing actuation during sensor noise or false positive detection.
architecture.expected_effect: Prevention of uncommanded emergency braking and unintended reverse movement while maintaining collision braking capability and stationary park retention through validated state confirmation.
architecture.falsification_test: Inject simulated sensor noise indicating an obstacle while the vehicle is in a non-neutral state; verify the system does not initiate emergency braking or reverse movement until the processor confirms the neutral braking mode.
